name: QQQ Valuation Stretch
description: QQQ Valuation Stretch — Z-Score of Log-Price vs Long-Run Trend. Uses rolling 504-bar (~2Y) mean as trend on log(close), then manually computes z-score of the residual using rolling mean and std over 504 bars. Includes dot-com peak event marker and era-based statistics table.
source:
# ============================================================
# QQQ Valuation Stretch — Z-Score of Log-Price vs Long-Run Trend
# ============================================================
# log(close) → rolling mean trend → residual → manual z-score
# Dot-com peak event marker + era-based statistics
# Using 504-bar rolling windows (~2 years) — max allowed period

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()
ts = index().value
close = src.c

# --- Log-Price and Trend ---
log_close = ln(close)

# Rolling 2-year mean on log-price as trend (504 trading days)
log_trend = ema(log_close, 500)

# Residual: how far log-price deviates from its rolling trend
residual = log_close - log_trend

# Manual z-score: (residual - rolling mean) / rolling std over 504-bar window
resid_mean = ema(residual, 500)
resid_std = agg(residual, 500, AggregationType.Std)
z_score = (residual - resid_mean) / resid_std

# --- Dot-Com Peak Detection (Jan 2000 – Jun 2000) ---
dotcom_start = Timestamp(value="2000-01-01")
dotcom_end = Timestamp(value="2000-06-30")
in_dotcom_window = ts >= dotcom_start and ts <= dotcom_end

# Z-score within the dot-com window
z_in_window = where(in_dotcom_window, z_score)

# Find the max z-score in that window (expanding max on filtered series)
dotcom_peak_val = agg(z_in_window, AggregationType.Max)

# Detect the bar where z-score equals the peak (tolerance match)
is_dotcom_peak = in_dotcom_window and is_valid(z_score) and is_valid(dotcom_peak_val) and (z_score >= dotcom_peak_val - 0.01) and (z_score <= dotcom_peak_val + 0.01)

# Only fire once — on the first bar matching
bars_since_peak = barssince(is_dotcom_peak)
is_first_peak = is_dotcom_peak and (bars_since_peak == 0)

# Peak label
peak_label = where(is_first_peak, "Dot-Com Peak")

# --- Era Definitions ---
era1_start = Timestamp(value="1999-01-01")
era1_end = Timestamp(value="2002-09-30")
era2_start = Timestamp(value="2002-10-01")
era2_end = Timestamp(value="2007-06-30")
era3_start = Timestamp(value="2007-07-01")
era3_end = Timestamp(value="2009-06-30")
era4_start = Timestamp(value="2009-07-01")
era4_end = Timestamp(value="2019-12-31")
era5_start = Timestamp(value="2020-01-01")
era5_end = Timestamp(value="2022-12-31")
era6_start = Timestamp(value="2023-01-01")

# Assign era number (1-6) for grouping
era_num = conditional_select(
    ts >= era1_start and ts <= era1_end, 1.0,
    ts >= era2_start and ts <= era2_end, 2.0,
    ts >= era3_start and ts <= era3_end, 3.0,
    ts >= era4_start and ts <= era4_end, 4.0,
    ts >= era5_start and ts <= era5_end, 5.0,
    ts >= era6_start, 6.0,
    0.0 / 0.0)

# Filter to bars with both valid era and valid z-score
valid_both = is_valid(era_num) and is_valid(z_score)
z_for_table = where(valid_both, z_score)
era_for_table = where(valid_both, era_num)

# --- CHART: Z-Score Over Time ---
xy_lines(
    title="How Stretched Is QQQ? Log-Price Z-Score vs Long-Run Trend",
    y_axis_label="Z-Score (σ)",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_label="",
    category="QQQ Valuation Stretch",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Valuation Stretch (Z)", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-1, to=0, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.08, label="Cheap"),
        PlotBand(from=2, to=6, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.08, label="Stretched")
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title="Neutral", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, title="Stretched (2σ)", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.LongDash)
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=z_score)

# --- EVENT MARKER: Dot-Com Peak ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Dot-Com Peak",
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Label", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="Z-Score", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="QQQ Close", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(peak_label, z_score, close, is_first_peak)

# --- TABLE: Era Statistics ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    category="QQQ Valuation Stretch",
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="QQQ Valuation Stretch by Market Era",
        col_headers=["Dot-Com Bubble", "Post-Bubble", "GFC", "Post-GFC Bull", "COVID Era", "Current (2023+)"],
        rows=[
            RowSpec(name="Avg Z-Score", agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            RowSpec(name="Max Z-Score", agg=AggregationType.Max,
                    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            RowSpec(name="Min Z-Score", agg=AggregationType.Min,
                    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            RowSpec(name="Last Z-Score", agg=AggregationType.Last,
                    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(z_for_table, era_for_table)
